baseline_models.mechanism: An overt speech act claims an inward, heart-settling assent; the construction keeps the declaration channel and the trust-state analytically distinct.

activation_trace.role: Emission of articulated speech supplies the overt declaration and frames faith as something said.
Assent in which the heart becomes settled supplies the inward state that the utterance claims.

changed_reading.before: They simply state that they now believe.
changed_reading.after: They voice a claim to settled assent, while the ayah leaves open whether saying can now install the state it names.

baseline_models.mechanism: Reaching requires an extension that closes an interval; place fixes the origin and distance puts the object outside that reach envelope.

activation_trace.role: Taking by extension and arriving at an object supplies the focus action of grasping across an interval.
Place or position supplies the situated origin from which the attempt is made.
Spatial or immaterial remoteness supplies the interval that the attempted extension cannot close.

changed_reading.before: Faith is simply unavailable to them.
changed_reading.after: The failure is mechanically relational: from their present position they cannot extend to and take hold of the claimed object.

baseline_models.mechanism: The reach-root can describe either making something arrive to another or taking a stricken one out of destruction, so the question can deny both self-grasping and an incoming rescue transfer.

activation_trace.role: Causing good or harm to reach another supplies an other-directed transfer channel.
Taking hold of an afflicted one to extract or save them supplies the rescue function of that channel.
Remoteness supplies the gap across which neither delivery nor extraction can operate.

changed_reading.after: No saving handoff or extraction is available to them across the distance.

baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative of whence, manner, or time is colored by the same root's image of reaching ripeness; combined with laterness and reaching, distance can be temporal as well as spatial.

activation_trace.role: Questioning place, manner, condition, or time supplies the overt challenge to possibility.
A thing attaining its proper time or ripeness supplies a latent acquisition window.
What comes after what was before supplies temporal separation from that window.
Reaching and taking supplies the acquisition that must occur while the window is live.

changed_reading.before: The question asks how they can reach across space.
changed_reading.after: It may also ask how an acquisition can ripen after its proper moment has receded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Saba sequence first constructs an inspectable, measured relay of settlements for safe travel, then has its users request longer intervals and become torn apart. The focus's far place therefore functions as the endpoint of dismantled connectivity, not an unexplained coordinate.

activation_trace.role: Extension that arrives at and takes an object supplies the focus's required traversal.
A connection standing between endpoints supplies the relay relation joining the settlements.
Going and flowing supplies successful traversal through the connected route.
Settled security against fear marks the original route as safely reachable.
Actively causing distance supplies the request to enlarge the intervals that must be crossed.
Tearing into dispersed pieces supplies the route-network's collapse into separation.

structural_cues: 34:18's safe measured chain immediately precedes 34:19's request for greater distance.
34:19 couples that spoken request with self-wronging and total dispersion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies safe measured links, a request for greater distance, and subsequent dispersion; I treat that history as a causal spatial analogue for 34:52. A live alternative is that the final distance is solely eschatological rather than self-produced.

changed_reading.before: They happen to stand too far away to grasp what they now claim.
changed_reading.after: Their unreachable position is the accumulated result of converting a traversable chain of nearness into separated intervals.

context_deltas.mechanism: A promise becomes a fixed appointment that cannot be moved backward or forward; regret follows sight of punishment, while truth has already arrived. The focus's distance is thus the wrong side of an irreversible event boundary.

activation_trace.role: Attaining a proper time or ripeness supplies the focus's latent acquisition window.
Reaching to take supplies the acquisition that the closed window now prevents.
An appointment that bounds a promise by time or place supplies the fixed event threshold.
Deferral to a later time supplies one prohibited direction of movement around the threshold.
Advancing ahead supplies the opposite prohibited direction, locking the appointment.
Grief over a missed matter supplies the affective state that appears only after seeing punishment.
Coming and obtaining presence supplies truth's completed arrival before the late declaration.

structural_cues: 34:29 asks when the promise is; 34:30 answers with a day that cannot shift by an hour.
34:33 locates regret at sight of punishment, and 34:49 marks truth as already arrived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed appointment, post-sight regret, and completed arrival; I infer that reaching in 34:52 cannot run backward across that boundary. The alternative is a purely spatial denial with no maturation or deadline component.

changed_reading.before: Distance means that the object is too far away now.
changed_reading.after: Distance also means that the valid acquisition moment is behind them; a declaration cannot be projected backward into the missed appointment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah explicitly defines what does and does not bring a person near: assets and descendants do not, while heart-settled faith is coupled with sound purposive action and security. The focus's bare late profession lacks the lived near-making trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Place and standing supply a focus position that can be relational as well as geometric.
Immaterial as well as spatial remoteness supplies the focus's negative relation.
Nearness as the opposite of distance supplies the relation that possessions fail to produce.
Nearness and standing supply the destination of the verse's approach relation.
Heart-settled assent appears in the route from belief to attained security, not merely as a spoken label.
Purposive action supplies enacted traversal rather than instantaneous verbal repositioning.
Soundness opposed to corruption qualifies the action paired with faith.

structural_cues: 34:37 grammatically rejects wealth and children as agents of nearness, then excepts the one who believed and acted soundly.
The same verse links belief to secure habitation, while 34:52 presents only a late speech act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit near-making test and couples faith with action; I project that relational metric onto the focus's far place. A live alternative is that 34:37 tests faith's fruits while 34:52's distance remains only spatial-temporal.

changed_reading.before: Far is a geometric description unrelated to the content of their profession.
changed_reading.after: Far also names a relation that status, assets, or instantaneous wording cannot cross; faith had an enacted path into nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier speech categorically refuses belief in the recited object and holds faith in negation or counterfactual blame, even while revelation and warning stand in the foreground. The final profession is a new utterance after an accessible relation was repeatedly refused.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the final profession as one utterance in a longer discourse history.
Heart-settled assent supplies the state that the late utterance claims to have reached.
Spoken refusal followed by exchanged blame supplies evidence that declarations can reverse while remaining speech.
The grouped occurrences hold belief first under categorical negation and later in an unrealized counterfactual.
Reading and recitation supply the previously available object explicitly refused.
What stands between or before the hands supplies foreground proximity rather than lack of access.
Covering or blocking truth supplies the immediately stated prior relation to the object.

structural_cues: 34:31 says 'we will never believe' before staging counterfactual believer-language in the blame exchange.
34:46 puts warning before their hands, and 34:53 explicitly contrasts the final claim with prior disbelief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit earlier refusal, foregrounded warning, and prior disbelief; I infer that the speech history blocks retroactive repositioning. Their final words may still be sincere as present recognition, but sincerity need not restore the lost opportunity.

changed_reading.before: A late declaration might itself establish the faith it names.
changed_reading.after: The declaration may register present recognition, but speech cannot rewrite prior refusal or reconstruct the earlier relation of access.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, escape is denied and they are taken from a near place; then their own reaching is denied from a far place. Near and far are therefore agent-relative: they remain fully within capture range while standing outside acquisition range.

activation_trace.role: Taking by extension supplies the failed outbound grasp from their side.
Remoteness supplies their position relative to the object they seek.
Failure of attainment or escape closes their attempted movement away.
Seizure and capture supply the successful incoming action upon them.
Place supplies the shared coordinate frame for the paired near and far constructions.
Nearness opposed to distance marks them as readily reachable by the capturing agency.

structural_cues: 34:51 and 34:52 are adjacent and mirror 'from a near place' with 'from a far place.'
The grammatical subject of successful taking differs from the possessors denied successful reaching.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored place phrases and opposite success values; I infer a directional asymmetry of agency. The alternative is that near only locates capture and far only marks the impossibility of return, without a broader agency model.

changed_reading.before: Distance is a single neutral gap applying equally in every direction.
changed_reading.after: They are near enough to be taken yet too far to take hold: judgment reaches them, but their late claim cannot reach back.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending contrasts two trajectories: truth is cast by one who knows the hidden and then arrives, whereas they cast speech at the hidden from the same distant place named in the focus. Reaching requires contact; their established epistemic method substitutes projection for contact.

activation_trace.role: Extension until contact and taking supplies the focus's standard of successful epistemic acquisition.
Throwing over distance supplies an incoming trajectory whose payload is truth.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the character of that incoming payload.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the domain known by the source of the truthful casting.
Coming into presence supplies truth's completed arrival and availability.
Throwing words supplies their opposite, outbound trajectory as verbal projection.
The hidden supplies the unseen target at which their words are projected.
Remoteness repeats the focus position and makes projection replace contact.

structural_cues: 34:48 and 34:53 repeat the same casting root with different agents and objects.
34:49 states that truth has arrived between those castings, while 34:52-53 repeat the distant-place frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated casting, opposed payloads, truth's arrival, and the shared distant place; I infer a contrast between grounded reception and speculative projection. A live alternative is that casting merely describes their prior claims and does not explain the failed profession.

changed_reading.before: They cannot reach because they are physically or temporally far away.
changed_reading.after: They also failed by method: instead of receiving arrived truth through contact, they projected words toward the unseen and finally tried to bridge the resulting distance with another utterance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah progressively closes every possible relay: invoked agents control nothing, mediation requires permission, no person controls benefit for another that day, and a barrier is placed between them and what they desire. The focus denies not only reach but transferable rescue.

activation_trace.role: Taking hold of an afflicted one to extract them supplies the focus's possible rescue channel.
Possession and power of disposal supply the control that the invoked agents are explicitly denied.
An intercessor joining another supplies a possible mediating relay.
Permission supplies the gate condition that restricts whether mediation can operate.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the outcome that no person controls for another that day.
An intervening barrier supplies the final physical-relational severance from the desired object.

structural_cues: 34:22-23 uses negation and exception to remove ownership, partnership, support, and unlicensed mediation.
34:42 says that day no one controls benefit for another, and 34:54 ends with an imposed barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies progressively blocked agents, permissions, benefits, and access; I map those closures onto the focus root's delivery and rescue branches. The live alternative is that tanawush denotes only their own grasping and not any third-party transfer.

changed_reading.before: The question denies only their personal ability to grasp faith.
changed_reading.after: It denies the entire transfer architecture: neither self-reach, proxy delivery, mediation, nor extraction can now carry the desired outcome to them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the eaten staff episode as a material analogy for epistemic belatedness. It remains anchored through the focus's ripeness, reaching, and distance branches and the episode's delay-collapse-disclosure sequence. Downstream prose should label it a cross-episode analogy, not a lexical meaning of tanawush.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَأَنَّى لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ as attempted recovery after delayed disclosure

activation_trace.role: Attaining proper time or ripeness supplies the focus's belated-recognition axis.
Reaching to recover an object supplies the post-disclosure attempt.
Delay past a thing's time supplies the material prop's extension of a false present.
A noisy, unstable fall supplies the abrupt collapse that ends the delay.
Appearance and disclosure supply the recognition produced only after collapse.
The hidden supplies what the workers could not know during their prolonged condition.

changed_reading.before: They recognize reality too late to act on it.
changed_reading.after: As with a support whose collapse finally exposes the hidden state, post-collapse recognition cannot recover what the period of delayed disclosure consumed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the reach-root's limited combat-contact image and the speech-root's negotiation branch into the final profession. It remains anchored in qalu, tanawush, and the surah's reciprocal blame-speech. Downstream prose should present it as a controlled parley metaphor, not as a claim that the verse literally depicts combat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالُوا آمَنَّا with التناوش as an attempted engagement from outside effective range

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over a matter supplies a possible parley function for the declaration.
Mutual engagement at weapon-reach but short of full contact supplies the range-limited encounter.
Returning speech or answer supplies the reciprocal blame exchange that resembles adversarial negotiation.
Repeated speech exchanged over responsibility supplies the contested matter of the parley.
The denial of benefit from one party to another supplies the failure of any negotiated outcome.

changed_reading.before: Their words merely report a newly held belief.
changed_reading.after: Their profession can be carried as a failed offer of parley from beyond effective engagement range, after reciprocal speech can no longer alter the outcome.

strongest_changes: The near/far pair becomes directionally asymmetric: they are within capture range but outside return reach.
The Saba route sequence makes final remoteness an engineered collapse of formerly safe connectivity.
The fixed appointment turns spatial distance into irreversible temporal distance.
The paired casting scenes distinguish contact with arrived truth from projecting speech at the unseen.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly converts the focus's compact reach image into route engineering, event timing, relational nearness, speech history, and opposed trajectories without requiring those mechanisms to collapse into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the final profession is inwardly sincere but ineffective, or only another verbal projection, remains open.
Whether tanawush activates rescue and mediation as well as self-grasping remains branch-dependent.
The delayed-staff and failed-parley readings are useful analogical outliers but should not control a conservative rendering.
